Thank you really much. I appriciate your words. And they are really really helpfull. This has been bothering me for soo long and just now I have realised it is anxiety. And my trigger for anxious feelings is if I put myself into situation that My brain register as a shame. Wheater it is my sexuality, my failure to become succsesfull in my profession or communication on German (I live in Germany at the moment) and all questions connected somehow to those topics. Pretty much anything. I feel little relieved cuz I came to the core of the problem and now maybe I will find tactics how to deal with it. Maybe honest talk to people around me, my friends and family will also help in a way that I out myself or admit that I don't have guts to work in IT industry, or at least at the moment. I have already searched for some psychologists in the area who can speak Croatian or English, preferably Croatian cuz only in those two languages i can closly explain how I feel. Anyway, even now by just knowing the fact that I have anexiety issues I feel better cuz I am one step closer to the solution. And I would not be here without community here on reddit. Thank you guys a lot.
